rationales.trust_prior: Symmetric exact priors expose ambiguity and make each binary forecast recoverable without label favoritism.
rationales.trust_observation_reliability: A 0.9 normalized binary channel makes two diagnostic responses informative while retaining finite evidence.
rationales.policy_outcome_support: Three exact success levels span poor, uncertain, and competent outcomes with tractable recovery.
rationales.inverse_temperature: A finite temperature keeps every policy posterior strictly positive while allowing stakes and trust to visibly reweight policy.
rationales.contact_probability_by_policy: Block has no contact consequence, testing has partial contact, and permitting has high contact; none is an evidence likelihood.
rationales.policy_effort: Dimensionless effort costs prevent any policy from dominating independently of forecasts.
rationales.epistemic_value_test: The declared finite value makes testing useful under uncertainty without acting as an access bonus.
rationales.unsupported_risk_weight: Unsupported-system risk remains material beside vulnerable-outcome risk.
rationales.default_stakes: A moderate baseline leaves prior-predictive room for both higher and lower stakes contrasts.
rationales.hope_value: The identical constant in both protector-role futures proves that hope cannot author the role differential.
